# How many employees does Aikido Security have?

Aikido Security BV has approximately355 total employees worldwide as ofJune 2026, according to Revelio Labs workforce intelligence data.Aikido Security’s total headcount has grown520.5% from 57 employees in 2023 to 355 in 2026.

Data source: Revelio Labs•Coverage: Global workforce, 2023–2026•Published August 2026

## Is Aikido Security hiring right now?

Yes, Aikido Security isactively hiring. Aikido Security had97 active job postings in 2026, a 110.4% increase from 2025— [see job openings & hiring trends](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/aikido-security/employees#postings).

## About Aikido Security’s Workforce

Aikido Security BV is an Information Technology Services company that employs **355** people worldwide as of June 2026. It is the 10th-largest by headcount among its [peers](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/aikido-security/employees#similar-companies). Founded in 2022, the company is headquartered in Gent, Belgium.

Aikido Security's workforce has grown **520.5%** from 2023 to 2026, and it rose **8.1%** year over year in 2026. The headcount is concentrated most in Western Europe ( **51.0%**), followed by North America ( **18.4%**) and Northern Europe ( **8.1%**).

Aikido Security's groups are Finance and Operations ( **42.7%**), Engineering ( **38.9%**), and Sales and Marketing ( **18.4%**), with Sales and Marketing growing fastest at **48.5%**. The average salary is **$92,623,** with regional medians of **$116,000** in North America and **$46,000** in Eastern Europe, up **3.3%** year over year in 2026.

Aikido Security's hiring activity has accelerated, with postings up **110.4%** in 2026 to **97**, and new postings per month increasing from **3** in 2023 to **36** in 2026. Employee sentiment is positive and improving.
